Locally served, lazy-loaded PDF assets. No CDN is contacted at runtime.

- jsPDF 3.0.4: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@3.0.4/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js (MIT)
- Noto Sans Regular: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/blob/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans/NotoSans-Regular.ttf (SIL OFL)

License files are included alongside the assets.
